verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms GoDaddy serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) whose index points agents to the quickstart, PAT setup, end-to-end workflows and machine-readable OpenAPI specs. A probe also confirms Markdown versions of doc pages, and the docs include an llms-full.txt and a dedicated agent-skill page for driving the gddy CLI. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community reports that agents actually work well when pointed at these docs.
